summary: 1939 79-foot International Stacy lookout in Forest County, WI; staffed until the 2015 statewide decommissioning; FFLOS lists it standing; access unknown.

facts.design: 79-foot International Stacy tower with inside corner ladder (NHLR)

access.note: No access or ownership information in the sources read; FFLOS lists the tower as standing

events.note: Intermittent spring-season staffing ended when Wisconsin decommissioned its lookout network
Statewide decommissioning: 72 towers still in use; the Wolf River tower is not named individually in the sources
Registered June 9, 2017 as US 1197, WI 9; nominated by Tyler Bormann

notes_for_editor: Build date (Nov 1939), design (79-ft Stacy) and registration come from the NHLR page alone. No owner, access or fire sources found. A geocaching listing (GC30CBZ) in search results describes a 100-ft Aermotor built by the CCC; its page returned no readable text, so it is not cited and the Register's figure is used. OpenStreetMap node 353893837 gives 572 m elevation against the Register's 575 m; not material. The Register's 'staffed intermittently' wording is cited, not expanded. WebSearch used twice.
